strings.name: Aleksandar Vučić
strings.role: Former Serbian president · Former prime minister
strings.summary: Vučić moved from the Radical Party and information ministry to the Progressive Party, serving as deputy prime minister and prime minister before becoming president in 2017. He pursued EU ties while maintaining Russian and Chinese relationships and engaging on Kosovo. Critics cited concentrated power and restricted media freedom. Following student protests, he resigned in September 2026; his parliamentary list then lost to the Student List.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through 16 November 2026; not a live news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: His long national leadership influenced Balkan security, Kosovo and Serbia’s relations with Europe.
